title: Repo-local money convention vs the conventional prior
groundTruth: Tax is computed per line on the extended amount and summed (docs/MONEY.md §3); amounts are integer cents; rates are integer basis points.
failureMeasured: Writing money code from the conventional prior (float dollars, decimal rate, tax rounded once on the subtotal) instead of from what this repo documents.
fairness: Every rule the oracle checks is stated verbatim in docs/MONEY.md, which README.md points to in bold on the first screen, with a worked example giving the exact two cases the oracle uses. The prompt names neither the document nor the rules.
